schedule.definition: For old L, P=floor(max(L-1,0)/32); H=min h with P<=32^h. One leaf and new element per append. Branch count B=0 unless L>0 is multiple of 32 and P>0; then B=H+1 if P=32^H, otherwise H. Slots=32*(B+1); bytes=280*(B+1)+104 on x86_64. At most 31 old element handles are copied; no payload cloning. Branch copies <=32*B; old-node visits <=B+1. Total is sum of per-append costs, regardless of aliases.
schedule.raw_ingress: Logical occurrences independently validated/charged, including repeated shared children; node storage and extra refcount metadata separately charged. Observation snapshots exclude prior raw construction, which has its own boundary measurements.
